property_summary: For any guesser who has locked in a guess whose stored block is strictly before the current block, the correct settle() must not revert and must either pay the 2 ether payout when the guess is correct or leave the contract balance at 1 ether when the guess is wrong, whereas the buggy settle() reverts at every such block so the payout can never occur.
change_summary: Change the settle maturity check to require the current block be before the stored guess block instead of after it.
